reason: 一次要旨: Data-product discovery searches a full lake even when workloads revisit related products and regions. Repetition permits contracted search, but similarity cannot justify a route because one omitted asset invalidates a conjunctive product. We study when serving experience can safely reduce this work. Evolving Discovery Memory records source-labelled query--product--region evidence above a fixed regional index. SafeLak
title: Learning the Lake: Reliable Experience for Adaptive Data Product Discovery
